newsitem.title: USA: 360 Communications Q1 hit by cloning fraud.
newsitem.headline: 360 Communications Q1 hit by cloning fraud.

text.p: 360 Communications Co said Tuesday its earnings and revenues for the first quarter both rose, but the results were affected by cellular cloning fraud.

The company reported net income of $9.4 million, or $0.08 a share, in the period ended March 31, compared with $7.0 million, or $0.06, one year ago. Total operating revenues rose to $306.8 million from $239.7 million, the company said.

360 Communications officials said the company has put systems in place to achieve an appropriate balance between fraud prevention and customer convenience, although fraud is an ongoing struggle in the wireless industry.
The company provides wireless voice and data services.
Its shares were off 3/4 Tuesday at 16-7/8.
